title: Workforce Skill meta.json
description: Workforce-specific operational metadata that lives alongside SKILL.md. Kept as a sidecar so SKILL.md stays portable to claude.ai / the Claude Agent Skills API.

name.description: Skill name. Must equal SKILL.md:name and the directory name.

version.description: Semver. Bumped on Rule-11 SKILL.md body PRs. First version is 0.1.0.

executor.description: How the runner executes this skill. llm-prose: LLM call → S3 artefact (+ optional Notion publish). claude-code-routine: LLM brief → GHA workflow_dispatch → pending DELIV. deterministic: sibling handler.ts in the same skill folder (auto-registered via workforce/scripts/build-skill-registry.mjs), no LLM call.

deliverable.description: Required for executor=llm-prose; forbidden otherwise. Declares the S3 prefix + Notion publish flag for the artefact.

cost_class.description: Projected per-invocation cost. small ~$0.05, medium ~$0.20, large ~$0.60.

owners.description: Agent slugs allowed to bind this Skill. Cross-checked against workforce/agents/.

improvement_agent.description: Agent slug assigned to improve this Skill. null until Epic-009 lands.

created_at.description: ISO date. Set on first PR; never edited.

requires.description: Credential types this skill reads from ctx.credentials. Each entry is a reverse-domain type id (service.field). The runner resolves each type from the active project at invocation time and seals the bag — undeclared access throws. To add a new type, extend this enum AND register the shape in shared/credential-injector.ts:CREDENTIAL_SHAPES.
